svg.title: Decode time, build by build: exact or lossy
svg.desc: Milliseconds of decode per 1,000 generated tokens, from Daniel's notebook to the 56.02 build. Each drop is colored by the kind of change that made it. Only the first drop was exact all the way through. How we split it: we read each build's recipe and tagged its changes exact or lossy, as in Part 2. A build that mixed both can't be split by milliseconds from our logs, so we name the lever that did most of the work, from what moved: games at once, tokens per pass or step time. At 6 Oct that was two more games and a better drafter (exact). At 11 Oct it was 32 games at once, which only fit because experts were cut and the history cache went to 4 bits (lossy). At 23 Oct it was more tokens per pass from verify depth and 4 draft steps (lossy). At 18 Oct we can't tell. From 6 Oct on, every build already carried lossy changes, so the 330 ms was never an exact number. Same runs as the time chart in Part 2; about 51% of the drop came in lossy-led builds and 6% in the all-exact one.
